versions.changelog:
Self-reflection-loop v1.0.0

- Introduces a Reflexion-style closed loop: structured self-assessment, tool-anchored validation (e.g., code compile/test), scoring, gap analysis, and improvement checklist.
- Iteratively refines outputs by injecting past lessons into each new generation, stopping at threshold or iteration cap.
- Supports customizable, reproducible rubrics for quality gating, observable progress, and deterministic evaluation.
- Built-in learning system automatically accumulates experience, adapts to user preferences, and improves efficiency and output quality over time.
- Offers workflow scripts for rubric initialization, artifact assessment, automated closed-loop refinement, and failure pattern logging.
